svg.title: Each of the 7 branches splits three more times
svg.text: Each of the 7 branches splits three more times
A few frames of slack in the house, at the crossroads and on the beach. Every branch still ends at READY.
Counted across all 7 branches: 19 farm, 54 ranch and 50 beach states, not 33 / 116 / 114: branches from different crowns grow into each other.
Sunny, horse: states counted per menu timing; slack = the timings the tables cover (68 VIs = 34 game frames ≈ 1.14 s after the menus).
